title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Golden Triangle Logistics Center in North Las Vegas
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of Golden Triangle Logistics Center, a Class A industrial portfolio totaling 1.3 million square feet in North Las Vegas, Nevada.
